package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for json_valid_then_unmarshal: Code that validates JSON and then unmarshals the same payload again.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
type Person struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Age  int    `json:"age"`
}

func parsePerson(data []byte) (*Person, error) {
	if !json.Valid(data) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON")
	}
	var p Person
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &p); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &p, nil
}
